task_title: DF-SPECLANG-12: persist gitreins verdicts so board closeout can bind an evidence run
task_criteria: history.enabled true plus history.storage git and max_verdicts in .gitreins/config.yaml, documented in docs/gitreins-verdicts.md, and a run's verdict is discoverable after task complete. failure_condition = config keys absent or not recognised by gitreins 0.21.0, or no discoverable verdict after a completed run. proof = the config diff, the gitreins-0.21.0 METADATA/engine config citing storage/max_verdicts, and a run id from .gitreins/history.

items.criterion: history.enabled true plus history.storage git and max_verdicts in .gitreins/config.yaml, documented in docs/gitreins-verdicts.md, and a run's verdict is discoverable after task complete. failure_condition = config keys absent or not recognised by gitreins 0.21.0, or no discoverable verdict after a completed run. proof = the config diff, the gitreins-0.21.0 METADATA/engine config citing storage/max_verdicts, and a run id from .gitreins/history.
items.detail: All three proof elements present. (1) CONFIG DIFF: `.gitreins/config.yaml:38-45` has `history:` / `enabled: true` / `storage: git` / `max_verdicts: 1000`; `git log -p -- .gitreins/config.yaml` shows commit d1490384 added `+  storage: git` and `+  max_verdicts: 1000`, and commit e9922bc8 flipped `-  enabled: false` -> `+  enabled: true`. (2) RECOGNISED BY 0.21.0: `gitreins --version` -> `gitreins 0.21.0` (pipx venv /home/kara/.local/share/pipx/venvs/gitreins). engine/config_schema.py:218-223 `_HISTORY = {enabled: KeySpec("bool"), path: KeySpec("str"), storage: KeySpec("str"), max_verdicts: KeySpec("any")}`, registered at line 264 `"history": _HISTORY`; engine/persist.py:100 `DEFAULT_HISTORY_CONFIG = {enabled, path, storage, max_verdicts}`; storage consumed at persist.py:220 (`storage_mode`) and max_verdicts at persist.py:952 (`_prune_old`). Runtime probe: `load_history_config('/home/kara/SpecLang')` -> `{'enabled': True, 'path': '.gitreins/history', 'storage': 'git', 'max_verdicts': 1000}`, `VerdictPersister.enabled=True storage_mode=git`. `gitreins config-validate` exits 0 and emits exactly six unrelated warnings (guards.assemble, guards.assemble_command, guards.build, guards.build_command, defaults.provider, defaults.api_key_env) and ZERO `history.*` warnings — the unknown-key detector ran and named nothing in this block. `gitreins report --json` emits `"producer":{"name":"gitreins","version":"0.21.0"}` and `"metadata":{...,"storage":"git"}`. (3) DISCOVERABLE RUN ID: `.gitreins/history/2026-11-16/579b2445/` contains verdict.json + summary.md + commit.patch + worktree.patch; `jq '{task_id,passed,pass_class,commit}'` -> `{"task_id":"DF-SPECLANG-2-R4","passed":true,"pass_class":"judged","commit":"6430f3701330128ab73830b82de7fc2bf06a51a9"}`. `gitreins report -n 6` lists completed tasks DOC-9, README-20, UX-003, DOC-7 as PASS. DOCS: docs/gitreins-verdicts.md:26-40 documents all four keys in a table with defaults, plus a runbook (lines 76-100) whose every command I ran verbatim and which returned the claimed results. Tests: `npx vitest run --passWithNoTests` -> `Test Files 107 passed | 4 skipped (111)`, `Tests 1912 passed | 58 skipped (1970)`, EXIT=0. [resolution 0.09; docs/gitreins-verdicts.md]

items.criterion: The three history keys are consumed by the installed gitreins 0.21.0 engine at runtime, not merely present in YAML — VerdictPersister reads enabled/storage/max_verdicts from this repo's config.
items.detail: engine/persist.py:108-127 `load_history_config` merges `.gitreins/config.yaml`'s history section over `DEFAULT_HISTORY_CONFIG` (line 122-126: `for key in merged: if key in config: merged[key] = config[key]`). Consumption points: persist.py:220 `storage_mode` property, persist.py:254 `if not self.enabled`, persist.py:313/346/549 `if self.storage_mode == "git"`, persist.py:952 `max_v = self.config.get("max_verdicts", 1000)`. Runtime probe against this worktree returned `enabled: True storage: git dir: /home/kara/SpecLang/.gitreins/history`, proving the YAML values reach the engine rather than falling back to defaults.

items.criterion: The documented discovery path actually works verbatim — every runbook command in docs/gitreins-verdicts.md returns the claimed result.
items.detail: Ran each runbook command in /home/kara/SpecLang: (1) `gitreins report -n 6` -> lists DOC-9/README-20/UX-003/DOC-7 PASS plus `Storage: git (/home/kara/SpecLang/.gitreins/history)`; (2) `gitreins report --json` -> schema-valid evidence doc, exit 0; (3) `find .gitreins/history -name verdict.json | sort | tail -3` -> three paths; (4) `jq '{task_id, passed, pass_class, tier2_skipped, commit}' .gitreins/history/2026-11-17/94482854/verdict.json` -> `{"task_id":"UX-003","passed":true,"pass_class":"judged","tier2_skipped":false,"commit":"ad5f0ec..."}`; (5) `git log refs/gitreins/history --format='%h %s' -3` -> `dd892ba6 verdict: UX-003 — PASS`, `92b22474 verdict: README-20 — PASS`, `34ebf809 verdict: DOC-7 — PASS`; `git show refs/gitreins/history:.gitreins/history/2026-11-16/579b2445/verdict.json` -> the DF-SPECLANG-2-R4 record. No runbook step failed.

items.criterion: The doc's citations of the installed tool are accurate (no fabricated file/line references), since the criterion's proof explicitly requires the gitreins-0.21.0 engine config citing storage/max_verdicts.
items.detail: docs/gitreins-verdicts.md:26-28 cites `engine/persist.py` `DEFAULT_HISTORY_CONFIG` and `engine/config_schema.py::_HISTORY`; line 43 cites `engine/config_schema.py:218` (`_HISTORY`). Verified in the real 0.21.0 install: `engine/persist.py:100 DEFAULT_HISTORY_CONFIG = {` and `engine/config_schema.py:218 _HISTORY: dict[str, KeySpec] = {` with `enabled`/`path`/`storage`/`max_verdicts` at lines 219-222, registered at line 264. Both files exist in /home/kara/.local/share/pipx/venvs/gitreins/lib/python3.14/site-packages/engine/. The doc's claim that `gitreins config-validate` flags six unrelated keys and no `history.*` key reproduces exactly (exit 0, six WARN lines, none history.*).

items.criterion: The durable (storage: git) copy is real — a verdict is recoverable from refs/gitreins/history, not only from the gitignored working tree, so closeout evidence survives working-tree cleanup.
items.detail: `git show-ref | grep gitreins` -> `dd892ba631fdfa70133675ca85590bbf93066286 refs/gitreins/history`. `git ls-tree refs/gitreins/history:.gitreins/history/2026-11-16/` lists `579b2445` among eight run dirs. `git show refs/gitreins/history:.gitreins/history/2026-11-17/94482854/verdict.json` returns `{'task_id': 'UX-003', 'passed': True, 'pass_class': 'judged', 'commit': 'ad5f0ec...'}`. The documented decision is consistent with the repo: `.gitignore:83` ignores `.gitreins/history/` and `git ls-files .gitreins/history` returns empty, exactly as docs/gitreins-verdicts.md:62-73 states.

items.criterion: The change does not regress the repo's test suite.
items.detail: `npx vitest run --passWithNoTests` in /home/kara/SpecLang -> `Test Files  107 passed | 4 skipped (111)`, `Tests  1912 passed | 58 skipped (1970)`, `EXIT=0`. Targeted `npx vitest run tests/config.test.ts` -> `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 6 passed (6)`, exit 0. Note: no test in tests/ references gitreins-verdicts/history.storage/max_verdicts — the change is config+docs only, so the suite is a regression guard rather than a direct test of the new keys.
